text:
Erin: Heads-up — weekly GPU capacity review. TL;DR: planned marketing spike in two weeks + large eval run. Can we align cluster provisioning by region?
Tony: Do we have expected GPU-hour delta?
Erin: Yes — baseline ~18k GPU-hrs/week -> expected +40% (≈25.2k) for weeks 12–14 due to retrain + heavy eval. Breakdown: 
```
US-west: +1.8k A100-80 GPU-hrs
EU-central: +1.2k A100-80 GPU-hrs
APAC: +0.5k A100-80 GPU-hrs (peak nights)
Cache preheat: ~200 vGPU-hrs
```
Priya: Can we shift some jobs to cheaper instances or quantized variants? cost delta: spot $0.22/hr vs reserved $1.65/hr per GPU.
Tony: For latency-sensitive routes we need dedicated. Suggest reserve ~60% of baseline + spot for burst. Keeps SLOs and lowers $$ for batch.
Jamie: Network note — last night we saw elevated fabric errors in eu-central1 on nodes in cluster-eu-ml-2; ~0.8% rx errors correlated with dropped streams, throughput dip ~6%. Ops ticket INC-7891 created.
Erin: Marking cluster-eu-ml-2 as degraded for scheduler; divert canary + small production canaries -> cluster-eu-ml-1.
Infra-bot: provisioning-ticket #P-4527 created: reserve 12 A100s in eu-central1 for 3-week window. ETA ~14h.
Priya: Also plan to precompile kernels & warm KV caches for our top-10 prompt families before the spike. Estimated warm-time 3h per cluster, saves ~12% token latency.
Tony: Quick cost back-of-envelope: additional reserve 12 A100 x 24h x 21d x $1.65 ≈ $9.98k; spot fallback cheaper but riskier.
Erin: Action items:
- Erin: finalize reserve quantities and signoff cost delta
- Priya: schedule quantized runs to shift non-latency retrains to spots/APAC off-peak
- Jamie: confirm INC-7891 mitigation & re-enable cluster when clean
- Ops: patch node NIC driver in eu-central during maintenance window (02:00 UTC)
Priya: If spots tighten, fallback is to run low-priority jobs in APAC night slots and bump up caching.
Tony: FYI tagging finance if monthly GPU-hours cross 100k this quarter :eyes: — they asked for a headcount of +GPU budget.
Erin: I'll run a cost-impact calc and post a short table before EOD. Meeting 10:30 PT tomorrow to lock plan. :calendar:
Jamie: Noted — I'll attach INC-7891 logs and a short perf blameless note.
Erin: Thanks all — please react with :thumbsup: when you ack your tasks.
